text: Question 8 6 points Suppose graph G is a directed, unweighted graph that is KNOWN to have exactly five strongly con- nected components. Your job is to determine how to add exactly 5 edges so that there is only ONE strongly connected component. Your job: Design an algorithm that solves the problem and carefully spec- ify each step. You may write things like "run DFS(G)” or "run DFS-visit(v)”, but you can’t simply state "find the SCCs”, since we did not see a procedure with this name in class. The output of your procedure must be the PAIRS OF VERTICES between which you add the edges. Justify the overall runtime of OV +E).
